summary: Tyler Technologies filed an 8-K on July 29, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 earnings and announcing a new $1.5 billion share repurchase plan approved by the board on July 24, 2026. The program replaces prior authorizations, though CEOs can still complete existing amounts. Repurchases may occur in open market or via Rule 10b5-1 plans, with no fixed expiration, no obligation to buy any specific amount, and can be modified or terminated anytime. The move signals management confidence and aims to return capital to shareholders. Watch for execution pace and potential EPS accretion, with no premium or deal terms applicable.
